import math
import sys

# Fast exponentiation
def beki(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    ret = beki(a, b // 2)
    ret = ret * ret
    if b & 1:
        ret *= a
    return ret

# Matrix class
class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, n=0, m=0):
        if n == 0 and m == 0:
            self.A = []
        elif m == 0:
            self.A = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
        else:
            self.A = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    
    @staticmethod
    def I(n):
        mat = Matrix(n)
        for i in range(n):
            mat.A[i][i] = 1
        return mat
    
    def height(self):
        return len(self.A)
    
    def width(self):
        if self.A:
            return len(self.A[0])
        return 0
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.A[idx]
    
    def __setitem__(self, idx, value):
        self.A[idx] = value
    
    def __iadd__(self, B):
        n, m = self.height(), self.width()
        assert n == B.height() and m == B.width()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] + B[i][j]) % mod
        return self
    
    def __isub__(self, B):
        n, m = self.height(), self.width()
        assert n == B.height() and m == B.width()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] - B[i][j] + mod) % mod
        return self
    
    def __imul__(self, B):
        n, m, p = self.height(), B.width(), self.width()
        assert p == B.height()
        C = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                s = 0
                for k in range(p):
                    s += self[i][k] * B[k][j]
                C[i][j] = s % mod
        self.A = C
        return self
    
    def __add__(self, B):
        return Matrix.from_existing(self).__iadd__(B)
    
    def __sub__(self, B):
        return Matrix.from_existing(self).__isub__(B)
    
    def __mul__(self, B):
        return Matrix.from_existing(self).__imul__(B)
    
    def __pow__(self, k):
        result = Matrix.I(self.height())
        base = Matrix.from_existing(self)
        while k > 0:
            if k & 1:
                result *= base
            base *= base
            k >>= 1
        return result
    
    @classmethod
    def from_existing(cls, other):
        mat = cls()
        mat.A = [row[:] for row in other.A]
        return mat
    
    def determinant(self):
        B = Matrix.from_existing(self)
        n = B.width()
        assert n == B.height()
        ret = 1
        for i in range(n):
            idx = -1
            for j in range(i, n):
                if B[j][i] != 0:
                    idx = j
                    break
            if idx == -1:
                return 0
            if i != idx:
                ret *= -1
                B.A[i], B.A[idx] = B.A[idx], B.A[i]
            ret *= B[i][i]
            vv = B[i][i]
            for j in range(B.width()):
                B[i][j] //= vv
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                a = B[j][i]
                for k in range(n):
                    B[j][k] -= B[i][k] * a
        return ret
    
    def rot(self, K):
        n = len(self.A)
        m = len(self.A[0]) if self.A else 0
        B = Matrix(n, m)
        for i in range(K+1):
            for j in range(K+1):
                B[i][j] = self.A[(i+K-1)%K][(j+K-1)%K]
            if i < n and (K < m):
                B[i][K] = self.A[(i+K-1)%K][K]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self.A[i][j] = B[i][j]

N, K = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
mod = 1000000007

INDEX = 0
copy = N
while copy >= K:
    INDEX += 1
    copy //= K

# Initialize matrices
mat = [[Matrix() for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(70)]

mat[0][0] = Matrix.I(K+1)
for i in range(1, K):
    mat[0][i] = Matrix.from_existing(mat[0][i-1])
    mat[0][i].rot(K)

for index in range(1, INDEX+1):
    mat[index][0] = Matrix.from_existing(mat[index-1][0])
    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[index][0] *= mat[index-1][i]
    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[index][i] = Matrix.from_existing(mat[index][i-1])
        mat[index][i].rot(K)

# Initialize answer vector
ans = Matrix(K+1, 1)
ans[K][0] = 1
used = 0

# Main loop
while INDEX >= 0:
    for i in range(K+1):
        if beki(K, INDEX) <= N:
            N -= beki(K, INDEX)
            ans = mat[INDEX][used] * ans
            used += 1
            used %= K
        else:
            break
    INDEX -= 1

# Sum the answer
val = 0
for i in range(K+1):
    val += ans[i][0]
val %= mod

print(val)
